decision: Enforce the predeclared complete canonical source scope before the existing remote snapshot; verify its sealed file ledger remotely; add component recipes using the existing test executor.
reason: Client isolation currently relies on manual reminders and remote synthetic Git cannot certify the canonical diff.
verification: Real Git scope/snapshot negative controls and old-entrypoint RED/new-entrypoint GREEN; exact nonzero canonical component recipes; unchanged full release gates and final native matrices.
not_tested: This accidental-edit guard is not server branch protection or a hostile-agent sandbox. A source component PASS is not physical client acceptance. No runtime correction, desktop/provider, owner or text transport changes.
